contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ CONSTANTIVS NOB CA[ES] ; R/ GLOR-IA EXERC-ITVS

A copper-alloy Roman nummus of Constantius II (AD 323-361) (Reece period 17). GLORIA EXERCITVS reverse type depicting Two soldiers standing either side of two standards. Mint of Trier. Obverse inscription: CONSTANTIVS NOB CA[ES]. Obverse description: Laureate, draped, and cuirassed bust right. Reverse inscription: GLOR-IA EXERC-ITVS. Reverse description: Two soldiers standing either side of two standards. Diameter: 17.63 mm; Thickness: 1.93 mm; Weight: 2.89g
